purpose: Prevent survivorship bias and future-information leakage in Korean equity factor research.
allowed_primary_sources: KRX Data Marketplace authenticated historical downloads
KRX Open API after user approval and authentication-key issuance
required_tables_per_month_end: KOSPI all-stock trading snapshot with close, market cap, and trading value
KOSPI all-stock PER/PBR/dividend-yield snapshot with BPS, EPS, and DPS
timing_rules: A month-end snapshot downloaded after the close is first usable at the next KRX trading session.
A signal may only read rows whose available_date is on or before the signal date.
Rows more than 45 calendar days old are ineligible.
Ticker membership comes from each historical snapshot; a current ticker list must never be projected backward.
Raw downloads are immutable and each file must be recorded with SHA-256 before normalization.
fail_closed_conditions: missing market cap, trading value, or close
duplicate ticker records for the same snapshot and availability date
data source other than an approved official source
development strategy attempts to read the sealed holdout directory
